title: 第369章  心安的存在
slug: 穿成星际废雌捡漏sss级兽夫赢麻了
content_zh:
士兵们被清出场外。
苏尘调试好仪器，
里面躺着一枚巴掌大的蓝色金属鳞片，泛着幽微的光泽。
苏尘一边取出来，一边解释：“这就是人造鳞片，安装过程有一定危险性但更大的风险在安装之后。”
“我还没来得及做足够的测试，但慕华烨现在的情况等不了了，至于装上之后是会提前引发暴乱，还是能稳定下来……都是未知数。”
姜知夏戳了戳意识中的大白花。
大白花似乎知道自己有任务了，花瓣一抖——“来吧！我准备好了！”
姜知夏接受到精神体的信号，点点头：“好，我准备好了。”
苏尘点头，朝姜霆和陆决示意。
“过程中他可能会醒，麻烦上将和少将做好镇压准备。“
两人同时颔首。
姜知夏抬手，将精神力缓缓释放。
手术的前半程，异常顺利。
姜知夏也没想到，这场手术全程不见一滴血。
苏尘把人造鳞片的数据录入那台磁场干扰仪器中，仪器发出低沉的嗡鸣，顺着十几条管道输出。
管道的另一头，贴在蟒蛇靠近心口的位置。
姜知夏低声问：“这个仪器，能让慕华烨接纳人造鳞片？”
她记得之前从姜怜身上拿回鳞片的时候，不是这样的。
当时幼年版的慕华烨好像很轻松就拿回来了，难道这就是本体鳞片和人造鳞片的取别？
苏尘一边盯着光屏上的数据，一边回答她：“对，这个仪器可以让他和人造鳞片的磁场同频，只有这样，他才能主动接纳人造鳞片。”

姜知夏：“如果接纳之后出意外呢？可以用这个仪器取出来吗？”
苏尘手上的动作顿了一下。
“当然不是，雌主，蛇族取出鳞片的方式只有一个——剖开身体，找到心脏，直接把心脏周围的鳞片剥离出来。”
姜知夏一顿。
原本因为怕蛇一直不敢低头细看的她，目光忍不住看向沉睡的蛇首。
慕华烨从小就被乔衍取走的那枚本命鳞片，就是这么活生生剖出来的？
他为了杀姜怜，难道也是用这种方式，亲手剖开自己的胸膛把鳞片取出来？
她不由得有些怜悯了。
……在慕华烨的所有记忆中，这种被活剖的痛苦，到底经历过多少次？
仪器中央的人造鳞片，散发出的蓝光越来越强，磁场开始剧烈波动。
蟒蛇的尾巴无意识地痉挛了一下，随后突然暴起！
“轰——！”
粗壮的蛇尾开始无意识的攻击，疯了一样四处挥舞！
姜霆和陆决眼神一沉，同时发力。
一个SS级以上，一个SS级顶峰，对上一个实力残缺的SS级，不太轻松但也说不上难。
两人的精神力如铁链般锁住蛇尾和蛇身，完全镇压。
幽绿的蛇瞳缓缓睁开，它张开獠牙，发出一声悲鸣。
“吼——！”
慕华烨醒来的第一感觉，是疼。
浑身上下的每一道旧疤都在疼，就好像那些早已愈合的伤疤在同一时刻被重新撕裂开一样。

幼年时期被一次次开膛破肚的伤，鳞片被生生剖出的伤，被掏空内脏的伤……
他疼得想要落泪，却连声音都发不出来。
就在这时，一阵温柔的风拂了过来。
那风很轻，带着莫名熟悉的馨香，一寸一寸地抚过那些灼烧的伤口。
好像很久以前，也有过这样的感觉。
是谁……
姜知夏一边释放精神力，一边惊讶的看着那个硕大的蛇脑袋。
慕华烨……哭了？！
巨蟒的蛇瞳浑浊涣散，充满哀伤的看着她，晶莹的泪珠从中滚落，砸在冰冷的地面上。
她犹豫了一下，伸手轻轻抚摸上去。
另一边的姜霆和陆决，两人依旧用精神力死死压着这条巨蟒。
就在这个时候，蟒蛇的躯体突然剧烈颤抖了几下，随后逐渐平静下来。
蛇尾缓慢地蜷缩起来，小心翼翼地朝一个方向围拢。
是姜知夏！
看到雌主要被蛇尾包围，姜霆和陆决脸色骤变，刚要动手——
姜知夏突然侧过脸：“别动！”
陆决和姜霆同时停下。
他们忍耐着撕开这条蛇的冲动，攥紧拳头。
姜知夏顶着头皮发麻的恐惧，任由那条冰凉的蛇尾轻轻缠上她的腰。
她能感觉到，此时的慕华烨即使没有理智，对自己也并没有恶意。

果然，粗壮的蛇尾没有一点攻击性，寻求安慰一般轻轻缠上她的手臂。
整个巨蟒逐渐缩小，再缩小。
仪器中的蓝色鳞片，骤然爆发出刺目的强光！
嗡鸣声攀升到顶点的瞬间，光芒消散！
苏尘盯着光屏上跳出的最终数据，缓缓吐出一口气。
“成功了。”
他转过身，看向场地中央。
姜知夏半蹲在地上，全身僵硬。
一条两指宽，一米多长的小蛇，正绕着她的手臂缓缓游动。
墨绿色的鳞片似乎都亮了不少，蛇脑袋吐了吐信子，十分依赖的蹭着她的手腕，虚弱的闭上眼睛。
姜知夏双手捧着那颗小小的蛇脑袋，颤颤巍巍地抬起头。
“苏、苏尘……他又晕过去了，怎么办？”
姜知夏就这么捧着那条小蛇，一路往医疗区走。
不是她不想放下，实在是慕华烨缠得太紧了。
蛇身绕着她的手腕一圈又一圈，不勒人，但比手铐还结实。
陆决跟在旁边，脸色很不好看。
他试着掰了两下，没能弄开，差点气的动粗。
姜知夏看那架势，担心他一个用力真给慕华烨直接拧断了。
她赶紧提议。
“先去医疗区给他检查一下再说吧。”

陆决一边走，一边盯着那条蛇，满眼杀气。
“都昏迷了还能缠这么紧？该不会是故意的吧？”
姜霆在后边，淡淡开口：“蛇族的本能，会缠住让他们心安的存在不放。”
这话一出，陆决的脸色更难看了。
姜知夏跟是差点左脚绊右脚，当场摔了。
她低头看了看那颗小小的墨绿色蛇脑袋，无奈地叹了口气。
什么心安，还不是高契合度的精神力，再加上被大白花给锁定了……
几人一路穿过基地走廊。
到了医疗区门口，迎面撞上了一个熟悉的身影。
钟泽初从里面出来，看到姜知夏身后跟着姜霆，苏尘和陆决，明显愣了一下。
他条件反射似的把手背到了身后，表情不太自然，结结巴巴地开口：“公、公主，上将，陆少将。”
姜知夏眼睛一瞪，纠正他：“是少尉！”
带兵上任的第一天，这个称呼非常重要！
钟泽初眼神一怔，从善如流地改口：“姜……少尉，你们这是……？”
他的目光落在姜知夏手上盘着的小蛇上。
姜知夏低头看看，嘴角抽了抽，“没事没事，你当没看见，倒是你，你在这儿干嘛？”
她上下打量钟泽初。
这看上去也不像受伤的样子，最近怎么总在医疗区看到他？
苏尘也看向他。
“钟少尉最近来医疗区的频率，似乎有些高了。”

钟泽初的脸，突然“唰”地红了。
他张了张嘴，支吾了半天，“我……我是来看看疏导者的。”
content_en:
The soldiers were cleared.
Su Chen adjusted the instrument.
Inside lay a palm-sized blue metal scale with a faint sheen.
Su Chen took it out and explained: "These are artificial scales. The installation process is somewhat dangerous, but the greater risk is after installation."
"I haven't had time to do enough testing, but Mu Huaye's current situation can't wait. As for whether it will cause riots in advance after being installed, or whether it can stabilize...it's all unknown."
Jiang Zhixia poked the big white flower in her consciousness.
The big white flower seemed to know that it had a mission, and its petals flickered - "Come on! I'm ready!"
Jiang Zhixia received the signal from her spiritual body and nodded: "Okay, I'm ready."
Su Chen nodded and signaled to Jiang Ting and Lu Jue.
"He may wake up during the process. Please prepare the general and major general for suppression."
They both nodded at the same time.
Jiang Zhixia raised her hand and slowly released her mental power.
The first half of the operation went extremely smoothly.
Jiang Zhixia also didn't expect that not a drop of blood would be seen during the entire operation.
Su Chen entered the data of the artificial scales into the magnetic field interference instrument. The instrument made a low hum and output it along more than a dozen pipes.
The other end of the pipe was placed near the python's heart.
Jiang Zhixia asked in a low voice: "Can this instrument allow Mu Huaye to accept artificial scales?"
She remembered that it was not like this when she got the scales back from Jiang Lian.
At that time, the young version of Mu Huaye seemed to be taken back easily. Could this be the difference between the original scales and the artificial scales?
While staring at the data on the light screen, Su Chen answered her: "Yes, this instrument allows him to have the same frequency as the magnetic field of the artificial scales. Only in this way can he actively accept the artificial scales."
Jiang Zhixia: "What if there is an accident after admission? Can I use this instrument to take it out?"
Su Chen paused in his movements.
"Of course not, Mistress. There is only one way for the snake clan to remove the scales - cut open the body, find the heart, and directly peel off the scales around the heart."
Jiang Zhixia paused.
She had never dared to lower her head and take a closer look because she was afraid of snakes, but she couldn't help but look at the sleeping snake head.
Is this how the life scales that Qiao Yan had taken away from Mu Huaye since he was a child were cut out alive?
In order to kill Jiang Lian, did he use this method to cut open his own chest and take out the scales?
She couldn't help but feel a little pity.
...In all Mu Huaye's memories, how many times had he experienced the pain of being dissected alive?
The artificial scales in the center of the instrument emitted increasingly intense blue light, and the magnetic field began to fluctuate violently.
The python's tail twitched unconsciously, and then suddenly burst out!
"Boom——!"
The thick snake tail began to attack unconsciously, waving around like crazy!
Jiang Ting and Lu Jue's eyes darkened and they exerted their strength at the same time.
An SS level or above, a peak SS level, facing an SS level with incomplete strength is not easy but it is not difficult either.
The two people's mental power locked the snake's tail and body like iron chains, completely suppressing them.
The green snake eyes slowly opened, it opened its fangs and let out a mournful cry.
"Ho--!"
Mu Huaye's first feeling when he woke up was pain.
Every old scar on his body ached, as if those long-healed scars were being torn open again at the same moment.
The injury of being disemboweled over and over again in childhood, the injury of having scales ripped out, the injury of having internal organs ripped out...
He was in so much pain that he wanted to cry, but he couldn't even make a sound.
At this moment, a gentle wind blew over.
The wind was very light, carrying an inexplicably familiar fragrance, caressing the burning wounds inch by inch.
It seems like I had this feeling a long time ago.
who is...
While Jiang Zhixia released her mental power, she looked at the huge snake head in surprise.
Mu Huaye... cried? !
Python's eyesHe looked at her turbidly and sadly, with crystal tears rolling down and hitting the cold ground.
She hesitated for a moment, then reached out and touched it gently.
Jiang Ting and Lu Jue on the other side were still pressing the giant python with their mental strength.
At this moment, the python's body suddenly trembled violently for a few times, and then gradually calmed down.
The snake's tail curled up slowly and cautiously gathered in one direction.
It’s Jiang Zhixia!
Seeing the female main body surrounded by snake tails, Jiang Ting and Lu Jue's expressions suddenly changed, and they were about to take action——
Jiang Zhixia suddenly turned her face sideways: "Don't move!"
Lu Jue and Jiang Ting stopped at the same time.
They clenched their fists as they resisted the urge to tear the snake apart.
Jiang Zhixia resisted the fear of numb scalp and let the cold snake's tail wrap around her waist gently.
She could feel that even if Mu Huaye was irrational at this time, he had no ill intentions towards her.
Sure enough, the thick snake tail was not aggressive at all, and gently wrapped around her arm as if seeking comfort.
The entire giant python gradually shrank and then shrank.
The blue scales in the instrument suddenly erupted with dazzling light!
The moment the buzz reached its peak, the light dissipated!
Su Chen stared at the final data that popped up on the light screen and slowly exhaled.
"Successful."
He turned around and looked towards the center of the field.
Jiang Zhixia squatted on the ground, her whole body stiff.
A small snake two fingers wide and more than one meter long was swimming slowly around her arm.
The dark green scales seemed to be a lot brighter. The snake's head spat out a message, rubbed her wrist very dependently, and closed its eyes weakly.
Jiang Zhixia held the small snake head in both hands and raised her head tremblingly.
"Su, Su Chen...he fainted again, what should I do?"
Jiang Zhixia just held the little snake and walked all the way to the medical area.
It's not that she doesn't want to let go, it's just that Mu Huaye is holding on too tightly.
The snake's body wrapped around her wrist, not suffocating, but stronger than handcuffs.
Lu Jue followed beside him, his face looking very ugly.
He tried to break it open twice, but couldn't get it open, and he almost became angry and violent.
Seeing that posture, Jiang Zhixia was worried that Mu Huaye would break it with just one force.
She suggested quickly.
"Let's go to the medical area to check him out first."
As Lu Jue walked, he stared at the snake with murderous intent in his eyes.
"You're still in a coma, but you can still be so tight? Could it be intentional?"
Jiang Ting was behind and said calmly: "The instinct of the snake tribe is to cling to the existence that makes them feel at ease."
As soon as these words came out, Lu Jue's face turned even darker.
Jiang Zhixia almost tripped with his left foot and fell on the spot.
She looked down at the small dark green snake head and sighed helplessly.
What peace of mind is, it’s not just the mental power of high compatibility, plus being locked by Dabaihua...
Several people walked all the way through the base corridor.
Arriving at the entrance of the medical area, I bumped into a familiar figure.
Zhong Zechu came out and was obviously stunned for a moment when he saw Jiang Zhixia followed by Jiang Ting, Su Chen and Lu Jue.
He put his hands behind his back like a reflex, with an unnatural expression on his face, and stammered: "Princess, General, Major General Lu."
Jiang Zhixia's eyes widened and she corrected him: "It's the second lieutenant!"
On the first day of taking office, this title is very important!
Zhong Zechu's eyes were startled, and he changed his words calmly: "Jiang...Second Lieutenant, what are you...?"
His eyes fell on the small snake coiled in Jiang Zhixia's hand.
Jiang Zhixia looked down and twitched the corner of her mouth, "It's okay, it's okay. You pretended you didn't see it. It's you. What are you doing here?"
She looked Zhong Zechu up and down.
It doesn't look like he's injured. Why do you keep seeing him in the medical area recently?
Su Chen also looked at him.
"Second Lieutenant Zhong's frequency of visits to the medical area seems to be a bit high recently."
Zhong Zechu's face suddenly turned red.
He opened his mouth and hesitatedAfter a long while, "I...I came to see the channeler."
